title: Morocco just ended Canada's fairytale — and their path is WIDE open

scenes.voiceover: Morocco just destroyed co-hosts Canada three-nil — and suddenly, their path to another World Cup semifinal is wide open.
Azzedine Ounahi scored twice, Hakimi set the first one up, and Rahimi added a third in stoppage time. Canada become the first co-host to go home.
Now look at the bracket. The 2022 semifinalists face the France-Paraguay winner on July ninth — win that, and Morocco are one game from back-to-back semifinals.
scenes.kicker: THE DARK HORSE PATH IS OPEN

scenes.voiceover: Is Morocco's run the real deal this time? The full bracket breakdown is on the channel — subscribe, the quarterfinals are about to get loud.
